How it works

From PDF to a signed copy anyone can check.

1

Send

Upload PDFs, add signers, approvers and people who get a copy, and place fields on one page, every page or a few.

2

Sign

A one-time code, then Start, Next and Finish on any phone. In order or all at once. No account and no app.

3

Seal

One sealed PDF: the signed pages and a one-page certificate with a QR code, under a PAdES seal.

4

Verify

Scan the QR for the public record, or drop the file on the verify page. No account needed.
